title: PVC attach failures during operator leader flips — customer escalation & mitigation
creator: Ava Chen
description: Multiple enterprise customers reported failing workloads immediately after rolling upgrades of the on-prem operator. Symptoms: transient Pod Pending states with PVC attach errors, followed by tenant autoscaling failures. Investigation shows operator leader election flapping during control-plane upgrades triggers a reconcile path that attempts a PV lifecycle operation while the kube-controller-manager is doing node rebalancing. Race condition in our attach/claim reconcile resulted in a short window where PVCs were marked for detach+reclaim, causing downstream attach failures and customer-visible outages.
comments: 2025-11-05 - Triage call: Customer A and B escalated (tickets ZD-9843, ZD-9897). On-call reproduced with a staged upgrade in staging-3 cluster.

2025-11-06 - Root cause hypothesis: operator attempts legacy 'reclaim-on-update' code path when leadership changes and Tenant CR modification timestamp is older than PV annotation. Confirmed via leader-election logs and reconcile traces.

2025-11-07 - Temporary mitigation: patched helm chart to add pre-upgrade hook that annotates Tenant CR with 'upgrade-in-progress' to short-circuit reclaim code path. Deployed to affected customers as emergency release (operator-2025.11.0-emergency).

2025-11-08 - Engineering design review: agreed on three-pronged fix: (1) make attach idempotent and tolerant to missing PV nodes, (2) add lease-based fencing to prevent concurrent reconcile attempts across leader flips, (3) extend helm preflight to block upgrades when kube-controller-manager reports pending node rebalances.
2025-11-09 - PR opened for idempotent attach & backoff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/1209 (WIP).
2025-11-10 - Customer comms: Sent status update for Customer A/B explaining mitigation and planned hotpatch; CS scheduled follow-ups for 2025-11-12 validation window.

2025-11-11 - Validation: ran chaos test simulating kube-controller-manager node eviction while flipping leader; observed attach backoffs prevent failing pods in 3/5 runs. Still observing one failing edge case where PV annotation TTL races with GC controller.
2025-11-12 - Decision to ship operator-2025.11.1-hotpatch with idempotent attach + lease fencing + preflight enhancements. Assigned rollout owner and runbook authoring.
acceptance_criteria: Operator releases idempotent attach flow and lease-based fencing (merged to main and tagged operator-2025.11.1-hotpatch)
Helm preflight blocks upgrade when node rebalance in progress or annotates Tenant CR to short-circuit reclaim path
Load test: zero PVC attach errors in 1000 simulated tenant upgrades with induced leader flips
Runbook updated and validated with on-call run-through
Affected customers validated in staging and confirmed recovery window <= 5 minutes
rollback_plan: If post-release errors spike: immediately revert to operator-2025.11.0-emergency using helm rollback to previous chart revision
Trigger tenant freeze via operator annotation 'upgrade-suspend=true' and coordinate manual attach with kube-admins
Escalate to SRE and activate DR playbook located in runbook attachments
next_steps: Finish PR 1209 (idempotent attach) and PR 1211 (lease fencing) - owner: Mateo Rivera - target merge 2025-11-13
Complete automated preflight check and add to helm chart - owner: Priya Patel - target 2025-11-14
Schedule canary rollout to 10% of Dedicated and Private clusters on 2025-11-16 - owner: Release Eng
Coordinate customer validation windows with CS for 2025-11-17 to 2025-11-19
notes: We should add a metric 'operator_leader_flip_count' and an SLO alert for >3 flips in 10m to detect risk earlier.
Post-mortem to include decision matrix for when to block upgrades vs allow quick leader handoff.
Consider shipping a small kube-controller-manager probe as part of our upgrade preflight that can surface node rebalancing state to the operator.
